payload.title: Domain-robust original-view coefficient learning
payload.statement: Using exactly one original 142-feature E011 vector per source well, a domain-balanced or distributionally robust training objective selected strictly inside outer-training partitions can preserve the original-only coefficient signal while improving worst spatial/typewell transfer without subgroup routing at inference.
payload.evidence_for: T027's original-view ridge reaches 12.4588330369, gains 0.0919232588 versus E011, improves all five horizon quintiles and all three special slices, and reduces p90 and worst-5% SSE share.
payload.evidence_against: The same comparator regresses spatial group 0 by 0.2840904830 and typewell groups 0, 2, and 4, including -0.3528384927 in typewell group 4. Optimizing evaluator groups can overfit their definitions and must never become inference routing.
payload.next_test: After the standing public-intelligence delta check, preregister T028 as a bounded original-view-only objective worth screen with all objective and selection rules frozen before scoring.
